msItem.title: ཨུ་རྒྱན་གྷུ་རུ་པདྨ་འབྱུང་གནས་ཀྱི་སྐྱེས་རབས་རྣམ་པར་ཐར་པ་རྒྱས་པར་བཀོད་པ་པདྨ་བཀའི་ཐང་ཡིག་ཅེས་བྱ་བ

dang shes rab snying po'i bka': nye bar gyur pa gsang sngags bsgrub pa'i lung : bden pa'i bka' 'chad nges pa'i don go phyir: u rgyan g+hu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi: sku gsum thugs yon 'phrin las mtha' rgyas pa: rnam thar stong phrag bcu dang brgya phrag dgu: ma 'ongs dam ldan don du bkod nas sbas: de thon mi la bsod nams snyan sgrags 'ong: g+hu ru'i rnam thar rgyas bsdus gang 'thad par: mthong thos mos gus tshad med bya ba gces:
msItem.author: u rgyan g+hu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs rnam par thar pa rgyas par bkod pa pad+ma bka'i thang yig ces bya ba ( ཨུ་རྒྱན་གླིང་པ)
msItem.incipit: chu 'brug zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad gza' zla ba dang skar ma dbo 'dzom pa'i nyin yar klung shel gyi brag rdzong pad+ma brtsegs pa'i ngos pad+ma shel phug gi sgo srungs khyab 'jug chen po'i thugs ka nas g+hu ru u rgyan gling pas/ las ldan gyi grogs gzhu kun ra ba hor sgom shAk dang bcas gter nas spyan drangs pa'o/ /... phyi mo'i rigs ji snyed pa bsags/ khyad par du gter ston gyi phyag bris las bshus zer ba zhig dang / yig rnying bal ris kyi dbu lha yod pa zhig dang / u rgyan gling pa 'i gdung brgyud kyis bzhengs pa e'i par ma gsum cung zad dag par 'dug pas ga bstun/ brda rnying dang yul gru tha dad pa'i skad bag tsam snang ba rang sor bzhag/ skabs 'gar go ba phyin ci log ci rigs 'dug pas/ mnga' bdag nyang gi gter ma rnam thar zangs gling mar grags pa sogs dang yang bstun nas gya tshoms su ma brgal bar nan gyis zhus te dag par byas yod pas rnam dpyod kyi blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis yid ches pa'i gnas su rig par bya'o//
msItem.explicit: ces dpal sangs rgyas gnyis pa o+oD+Di ya na'i slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rnam par thar pa gter kha gong 'og ba khal smug po sogs gter byon mang por rgyas bsdus dang / gdul bya'i blo dang bstun pa'i rigs mi gcig pa sna tshogs snang zhing pad+ma bka'i thang yig la yang rdo rje gling pa sangs rgyas gling pa sogs gter kha 'ga' yar 'dug pa'i rgyal sras lha rje gter ston rkyang pa'i skye ba bcu gsum blangs pa yar rje o+yan gling pas bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtshos thog drangs chos bka' mtha' klas pa bton pas gter smyon du grags shing pad+ma bka'i thang yig 'di nyid chu 'brug zla ba bzhi pa'i tshe brgyad gza' zla ba dang skar ma dbo 'dzom pa'i nyin yar klungs shel gyi brag rdzong padma brtsegs pa'i ngos padma shel gyi phug gi sgo srung khyab 'jug chen po'i thugs ka nas gu ru o+yan gling pas las ldan gyi grogs gzhu kun ra ba hor pa sgom shAkya dang bcas gter nas spyan drangs pa la yi ger lhad zhugs pa'i dpe sna tshogs zhig 'dug pa lo chen bai ro 'i rnam [f. 225v] 'phrul gter ston shes rab 'od zer kyi dgongs pa skong slad/ rgya gar gyi rgyal rigs sA la pa chen po/ bod yul 'dir gnam gyis bskos pa'i rgyal po dpal phag mo gru pa 'i mdun na 'don/ hor mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal gyis sbyin bdag mdzad/ gter ston gyi phyag bris ma'i bu yig sogs yi ge rnying pa khungs btsun pa rnams la brten nas paN chen ri zangs tog pas zhus dag pa'i 'phyong rgyas dpal ri'i par zhes tshad thub tu byed na'ang 'phrin las ha cang ches pa'i yig 'bru thor ba dang mi gsal ba kha yar 'dug pa lho brag sprul sku'i chos 'byung dang sog bzlod pa blo gros rgyal mtshan zhes pa rnam dpyod dang ldan pa des brtsams pa'i o+yan chen po'i rnam thar ltar gter ston rdo rje gro lod kyi lung bstan dpe rnying pa lcags smyug ma nas rnyed pa mchog sprul legs ldan rdo rje'i dus rtags sogs gsal por snang bas gsar du bcug pa tsam las bcos med 'di dpal o+yan chen po'i zab gter nas lung gis zin pa grong smad pa sangs rgya rgya mtshos par gsar pa zhig brkos na zhes bskul bas rkyen byas / rang nyid kyang mi phyed pa'i dad pas yid drangs te kha ba ri pa rnams la gcig tu phan pa'i chos sbyin mi zad pa'i par za hor gyi rigs las sngags pa rgan po che mchog 'dus pa rtsal pad+mas ming btags rdo rje thogs med rtsal du 'bod pas par byang dang bcas te 'du gyis nas shing yos dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du brkos rgyur bsrings pa/ par zhus dang do dam pa yar 'brog pa dge slong blo gros brtan pa/ rtse skor ba dge slong blo gsal mkhas pa/ bkras gling dge slong smra ba'i dbang phyug gsum dang / yig mkhan blo bzang dam chos/ ... dbu bla 'di mi bzhad pa mtha' yas rnams kyis byas te me 'brug khyu mchog zla ba'i nyer bzhi'i rgyal phur gyi 'grub sbyor thog legs par grub pa'i par byang gi yi ge pa rigs 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa 'dis kyang stod smad bar gsum gyi 'dre ngan sogs nag po bdud kyi dpung tshogs rmed med du 'joms shing bde skyid rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la 'gran pa'i dga' ston la spyod pa'i bsams don ma lus pa lhun gyis grub par gyur cig/ mang+ga laM/ /bkra shis/ /
msItem.colophon: "This is a biography of Padmasambhava, printed in 1675 in dGa' 'dan Phun tshogs gling. The Vth Dalai Lama edited the text using various sources. There is a copy under shelfmark Tib. blockbooks a.29"

supportDesc.foliation: "The title page is missing. The sixth folio is from another text (not a terma), it does not belong in that place (it has been previously foliated in middle of this gter ma text). Thus, it is left as it is. The last two folios (225, 226) are handwritten, perhaps written to replace the xylographic pages which might have fallen apart. folio 226v has pencilled ""Tib. a. 98"""

handDesc.handNote: "Line drawings on folio 1 verso: Mkha' 'gro Gtso mo mkhar chen bza', Sangs rgyas gnyis pa rgyan pa, Zab gter 'byed mdzad oyen ; f.2r, Mnga' ris gter chen legs ldan rje [gTer ston Legs ldan rDo rje], Chos rgyal rin chen phun tshogs zhabs ; f.2v Bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po sde, Rigs 'dzin kun dga' tshe mchog rje ; f.3r, Sngags 'chang gzhon nu don grub dpal, Kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang sar grol."
